_source: BSM1_R2019b/Results/openloop_dyn.pdf -- Dynamic open-loop BSM1 reference, dry-weather influent, performance over days 7-14 after a 500-day constant-input steady state plus a 14-day dry burn-in. Matlab/Simulink implementation by U. Jeppsson, IEA, Lund University, 2009-05-21. Two index conventions are reported by the benchmark code: 'original BSM1 version' and 'updated BSM1 version' (the update revises the aeration/pumping energy and the EQI/IQI weighting). The averaged effluent concentrations below are convention-independent.
